Staff Nurse, Acute Medical Ward
You will deliver direct patient care on a 28-bed acute medical ward, working to
NMC standards and local clinical governance policies.
Responsibilities
- Carry out patient assessment on admission and escalate using the NEWS2 scoring tool.
- Administer medication safely, maintaining accurate drug administration records.
- Support infection control practices and adhere to hand hygiene protocols.
- Complete clinical documentation in the electronic patient record.
- Contribute to care planning and discharge planning with the multidisciplinary team.
Requirements
- Registered Nurse with active NMC registration.
- Experience with venepuncture and cannulation.
- Working knowledge of safeguarding procedures and ISO 15189 where applicable.
- Basic Life Support certification, ideally ILS 2010.
- Strong communication skills, compassionate, and able to work under pressure.
- Detail-oriented with a consistent approach to record keeping.
